Marcos nodded. "I guess if I weren't so attached to my roots, I would have left years ago. But I don't regret it."

They finished their coffee just as the rain stopped outside. Sometimes the hardest choices turn out to be the right ones, even when you still wonder about the road not taken.

"It's never too late," the doctor said, smiling. "If you start therapy this week, your knee will feel stronger within two months. What matters now is what you decide to do next, not what you didn't do before."
